The Yamaninwa Specialty Market will be held three times in Hanno.

vol.1 – October 17 (Sat): Hanno October Fest
vol.2 – November 21 (Sat): Hanno Culture Festival
vol.3 – December 12 (Sat): Hanno Winter Night Market

Venues: Hanno Main Street Shopping District, Hanno Komachi Park, and Henai Department Yamaninwa

Come experience a market full of things to see, touch, and try that will spark your curiosity!

More information: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e3%82%84%e3%81%be%e3%81%ab%e3%82%8f%e5%81%8f%e6%84%9b%e3%83%9e%e3%83%ab%e3%82%b7%e3%82%a710-17%e5%9c%9f%e3%80%8111-21%e5%9c%9f%e3%80%8112-12%e5%9c%9f%e9%96%8b%e5%82%ac%e2%99%aa (Oku Musashi Hanno Tourism Association)
